iphone.title: Turn on Stolen Device Protection (iOS 17.3+)
iphone.look: Settings › Face ID & Passcode › Stolen Device Protection
iphone.why: Someone who has seen your passcode still can't change your Apple Account password without Face ID and a security delay.

iphone.title: Turn on Find My, including Send Last Location
Set a SIM PIN
iphone.look: Settings › Mobile Service (or Cellular) › SIM PIN
iphone.why: Stops a thief moving your SIM to another phone to receive your security codes by text.
iphone.warn: You need your network's default PIN. Three wrong tries lock the SIM until you get the PUK code from your network.

iphone.title: Block Control Centre on the lock screen
iphone.look: Settings › Face ID & Passcode › Allow Access When Locked › Control Centre (off)
iphone.why: Stops a thief switching on flight mode to go offline.

iphone.title: Use a longer passcode (not a birthday) and shield it when you type in public

android.title: Turn on Theft protection: Theft Detection Lock, Offline Device Lock and Remote Lock
android.look: Settings › Google › All services › Theft protection. Names vary by manufacturer, and some features need newer Android versions.
android.why: The screen locks if someone snatches the phone and runs.

android.title: Turn on Find My Device (called Find Hub on newer phones)
Set a SIM PIN
android.look: Settings › Security › SIM card lock (or similar)
android.why: Stops a thief moving your SIM to another phone to receive your security codes by text.
android.warn: You need your network's default PIN. Three wrong tries lock the SIM until you get the PUK code from your network.

android.title: Turn on Identity Check, on supported phones with newer Android
android.look: Settings › Google or Security (varies by phone)
android.why: Asks for your fingerprint or face before key settings change away from trusted places.

android.title: Use a longer PIN or password and shield it when you type in public

both.title: Write down your IMEI and keep it off the phone
both.why: Networks and police use it to block the phone.

both.title: Turn on two-step verification for email and banking
both.why: Prefer an authenticator app or passkeys over text codes.

both.title: Save your network's lost/stolen number and a trusted contact somewhere off your phone
both.why: Visitors: also save your home network's international number and your embassy's details.

habits: Keep your phone away from the kerb. Many snatches are from bikes and e-bikes.
Step into a doorway or shop to check maps.
Don't stop at station exits to use your phone.
On busy streets, keep it in a front zip pocket or use a wrist strap.
